A bulk food storage bag in the storage room was open and at risk of contamination by rodent droppings. A representative
said increase rodent control was added and no more rodents have been seen, however rodent droppings were seen on
the top flap of the food bag. Food contaminated by rodent droppings could make dogs sick. Ensure that open supplies of
food are stored in a manner that protects them from spoilage, contamination, and vermin infestation. Open supplies of
food and bedding must be kept in leakproof containers with tightly fitting lids to prevent contamination and spoilage.
***Correct by 8/11/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
